title: Shadow Knight in Poppy Field
description: A towering armored knight with glowing white eyes stands amid a vast field of purple lavender, reaching toward an enormous glowing white lily. Smaller identical armored knights ride ornate green elephants across the surreal landscape, surrounded by giant red and orange poppies under a dramatic purple sky.
